description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an NLP Engineer based in United States. 

 As an NLP Engineer, you will develop, train, and optimize advanced language models powering intelligent conversational experiences and AI-driven products. You will work across the entire machine learning lifecycle, from dataset preparation and model fine-tuning to evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. Your focus will be on adapting language models to evolving conversational scenarios, improving response quality, and ensuring reliable and efficient model performance. You will experiment with different models, prompting strategies, and inference technologies to balance accuracy, latency, and operational costs. Working closely with engineering and product teams, you will transform NLP research and experimentation into scalable, production-ready solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to globally distributed digital products within an international, remote-first technology environment.



Accountabilities:
 

 Language Model Development: Train, fine-tune, and improve language models used in AI-powered conversational assistants and copilots. Adapt models to new conversation scenarios, response requirements, and structured output formats.

 Dataset Preparation and Management: Build, prepare, and maintain high-quality training and evaluation datasets. Identify data gaps, analyze model errors, define annotation requirements, and review annotated examples to improve model performance.

 Model Selection and Prompt Engineering: Evaluate and compare internally hosted language models with external model APIs, assessing response quality, latency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Develop and optimize prompts to achieve consistent and relevant outputs.

 Model Evaluation and Benchmarking: Maintain evaluation datasets and performance benchmarks, using automated assessments, human reviews, and other evaluation techniques to measure generated text quality. Identify regressions, investigate unsatisfactory responses, and incorporate user feedback into improvements.

 Model Deployment and API Development: Build, package, and maintain services and APIs around language models using FastAPI or comparable frameworks. Support reliable deployment and integration of models into production applications.

 Inference Optimization: Improve model inference speed, GPU memory utilization, and serving costs while maintaining the required response quality and performance standards.

 Production Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Implement logging, monitoring, and appropriate testing processes to maintain production reliability. Investigate technical issues, manage deployment failures, and support rollback procedures when necessary.

 Recommendation Systems: Contribute to recommendation-related capabilities and explore opportunities to apply NLP and machine learning techniques to improve product experiences.

 Technical Documentation: Maintain reproducible experiments, document technical decisions and results, and ensure solutions are understandable and maintainable by other engineering team members.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with engineering and product stakeholders to translate requirements into effective NLP solutions and deliver improvements to AI-powered features.


 Requirements:


 Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing clean, maintainable, production-quality code beyond research notebooks.

 Practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face Transformers, including a solid understanding of transformer architectures, tokenization, model training, and text generation.

 Hands-on experience adapting and fine-tuning language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA.

 Strong understanding of dataset preparation, validation, quality control, and data leakage prevention.

 Ability to investigate model errors, identify weaknesses in training data, and develop strategies to improve model performance.

 Experience evaluating generated text using benchmarks, automated evaluation methods, and human review.

 Understanding of the strengths, limitations, and trade-offs of different language models and evaluation approaches.

 Practical experience working with model APIs, prompt engineering, and structured output generation.

 Experience developing and maintaining APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent backend framework.

 Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and Git, including experience deploying machine learning models on GPU infrastructure.

 Knowledge of model inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM or equivalent technologies.

 Experience implementing logging, monitoring, automated tests, and production troubleshooting procedures.

 Ability to investigate production failures, identify root causes, and manage safe release or rollback processes.

 SQL proficiency sufficient to retrieve, query, and analyze product data.

 English proficiency sufficient to understand technical documentation, research papers, and communicate technical concepts.

 Practical experience with recommendation systems, even at an introductory or project level.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to experimentation.

 Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed engineering team.


 Benefits:


 Fully Remote Work: Full-time remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from different locations.

 Competitive Compensation: The initial salary level or compensation range will be communicated during the recruitment process, before employment begins.

 Generous Annual Leave: 28 calendar days of paid vacation per year.

 Wellness Days: 7 additional wellness days annually to manage personal matters, rest, or recover without using sick leave.

 Children's Education Support: Reimbursement of 50% of kindergarten or school expenses, up to $1,000 gross per year per child, subject to eligibility after the integration period.

 Referral Bonuses: Bonuses of up to $5,000 for recommending successful candidates for open positions.

 Professional Development: 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.

 Language Learning: Corporate discounts for English language lessons.

 Healthcare Support: Health insurance benefits or reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee for eligible healthcare expenses, including personally purchased insurance and medical consultations for employees and close family members.

 Remote Workplace Support: Workplace equipment and infrastructure provided in company offices or coworking locations. Employees working elsewhere may receive reimbursement of up to $1,000 gross once every three years for home-office equipment, internet, or coworking expenses.

 Employee Recognition Program: Access to an internal gamified appreciation system where colleagues can award bonuses that can be exchanged for company merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.

 International Work Environment: Opportunity to collaborate with a globally distributed team of technology professionals and contribute to products used across different markets.
